scope: The complete game (1.0.1, harder): the PRG unpacked, the title with its menu of audio modes and PRESS FIRE, the whole dungeon (sixteen rooms in four zones, objects, doors, the portal, explorer, sword, skeletons and bats, damage, HUD), the end of a game in the room and on its end screen with score, seals and rooms, the way back to the title; the music, its pieces for the end of a game, the sound effects and silence, no note left sounding; won and lost games with the joystick only, seven games without loading again; the memory map

unpack.no_unpack: step 07: every block assembled at its address, so the PRG has holes
unpack.checks: every block equal to its generated file (the music to the assembled bytes) in the PRG and in memory at its address

title_draw_room.method: raster position (LIN*63+CYC) at every cell row of the title page; each interval shorter than a frame; includes the sound interrupt

music.method: on the title, MUSIC mode: raster position at audio_irq and irq_done; SID shadow equal to tests/player_model.py after every interrupt
